bufflist.desc.aether.inebriation: Takes 1 inebriation damage every 2.5 s; you drift randomly, the camera sways and the screen gets a dizzy filter. Applied by Aechor Plants, Poison Darts, Skyroot Poison Buckets and the like; cured by Remedy.
bufflist.desc.aether.remedy: Removes Inebriation every tick and makes you immune to it. Comes from eating a White Apple (15 s) or drinking a Skyroot Remedy Bucket (10 s).
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.bubbled: Out of water (unless aquatic or water-breathing): horizontal speed ×0.8 every tick, air drops by 2 per tick and doesn't refill; once it runs out, take 2 drowning damage every 0.5 s. Entering any liquid ends it. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.darkness_incarn: Creative-style flight at 4× the normal flying speed, no fall damage. Light level 11 or higher (including open daylight) ends it at once; you get one Slow Falling afterwards. Given by the Cloak of Darkness for 10 s by default; eating a Darkened Apple during it adds 30 s. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.deepsight: See further underwater: fog distance ×2.5 in water (also acid, purple soda and primordial lava), and the water looks a bit brighter. Fades in over 1 s.
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.irradiated: Can't heal by any means and you glow. From level II, take 1 radiation damage every {=10/(lvl-1)} s (each hazmat piece worn: -0.25 damage and -25% chance); without hazmat gear it also drains hunger. Level I only blocks healing. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.magnetizing: You become magnetic: nearby magnets pull or push you, and you can walk on magnetic blocks (sneak to let go). Magnetic robot mobs are immune.
bufflist.desc.alexscaves.rage: Attack damage grows with missing health: +(missing health fraction × {=lvl*2.5}), so 0 at full health and close to +{=lvl*2.5} when nearly dead. A mob with this and no target has a 50% chance every 0.5 s to pick a random mob within 80 blocks and attack it.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.bug_pheromones: Arthropods (spiders, silverfish, bees, etc.) won't target you unless you hit them first.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.clinging: Walk upside down on ceilings: with a block underside within about 1.5 blocks overhead and not on the ground, you get 0.3 upward push per tick and no fall damage. Sneak to drop.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.earthquake: The screen shakes hard; no damage by itself. Applied for 1 s when a Rocky Roller slams into the ground.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.ender_flu: Bursts when it ends: take {=lvl*10} magic damage and {=lvl} Enderiophages crawl out of you. Getting infected again by an Enderiophage raises the level (max V) and lasts 10 min. Eating a chorus fruit has a 1/3 chance to cure it; right-clicking a mob with a chorus fruit has a 40% chance.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.exsanguination: Take {=lvl} magic damage per second (never more than the seconds left). Applied at level III for 3 s by a Frilled Shark bite, or when blocking an attacker within 4 blocks with the Shield of the Deep.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.fleet_footed: While sprint-jumping (airborne and sprinting), movement speed +0.2 (player base is 0.1, so about 3×); the bonus goes away 5 ticks after landing. Attacking a jerboa removes it. Get it by feeding a jerboa; lasts 10 min.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.lava_vision: See clearly in lava: lava turns see-through and fog is pushed out to 50 blocks while inside it. Visual only; no fire protection.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.mosquito_repelle: Crimson Mosquitoes won't target you and flee from mobs with this effect within 20 blocks. Get it from Mosquito Repellent Stew.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.oiled: In water or rain you float up 0.1 per tick (like buoyancy); hold sneak to stay down, which also resets fall distance. Get it by drinking Fish Oil; lasts 60 s.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.poison_resistanc: Immune to poison: removes Poison from you every tick.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.soulsteal: When you deal damage while hurt, {=min(100,25+25*lvl)}% chance to heal {=lvl*50}% of the damage dealt, up to {=2+2*lvl} HP per hit.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.sunbird_blessing: No fall damage, and falling speed ×0.6 per tick while not sneaking (like Slow Falling). Elytra gliding with a pitch above 10° gives extra lift. Attacking a Sunbird removes it and gives you 30 s of Sunbird's Curse instead.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.sunbird_curse: Can't glide with an elytra (it gets closed), and you're pulled down an extra 0.2 per tick while off the ground; players flying in creative aren't pulled. Comes from attacking a Sunbird; lasts 30 s.
bufflist.desc.alexsmobs.tigers_blessing: Tigers won't target you, and adult tigers within 32 blocks join in on whatever you attack. Attacking a tiger removes it. Get it by feeding a tiger; lasts 10 min.
bufflist.desc.apotheosis_modern_ragnarok: Keeps you burning with fire damage ×{=lvl} (normally 1 per second, so {=lvl} per second). The level depends on the fire bullet's damage. Fire-immune mobs lose it at once; if Frozen is also present, the two cancel out.
bufflist.desc.apotheotic_additions.bad_v: Constant magic damage: 2 per hit, limited by hurt invulnerability, so about once every 0.5 s (about 4 per second). Doesn't scale with level.
bufflist.desc.attributeslib.bleeding: Take {=lvl} bleeding damage every 2 s (+1 per level).
bufflist.desc.attributeslib.detonation: When it ends or is removed while you're on fire, the fire goes out and you take damage based on the burn time left: {=lvl*20/14} per remaining second (+1.43 per level).
bufflist.desc.attributeslib.sundering: Damage taken +{=lvl*20}% (+20% per level), basically negative Resistance; the two cancel each other. Damage that bypasses Resistance isn't affected.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.bad_feeli: A 0.5 s warning: at sunset on day 3 it means the Nightmare Stalker has started hunting you; at sunset on day 10, powerful beings (mini-bosses like the Preacher) start invading. Needs the matching gamerules on. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.barbedatt: Hidden internal cooldown for weapon bonus damage, 0.5 s: during it the Dark Metal sword's bonus vs undead and the Spiny Shell mace's bonus vs targets in water won't trigger again.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.block_bre: Hidden guard break: shield-carrying mobs like Door Knights and Skeleton Thrashers can't block, and some mobs can't use summon skills. Applied for 6 s when hit by an axe. A player who gets it while holding a shield puts the shield on a 5 s cooldown.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.bone_barr: Constant Resistance V (no damage at all) until you're hit once, then the barrier breaks and the effect ends. Get it from a Bone Heart; lasts 50 min. Can't use another while it's active.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.cursed_ma: When it ends or is removed, a Scarlet Persecutor spawns 3 blocks away to the north, south, east and west (if not blocked), up to 4. Applied by Fallen Chaos Knight hits, lasts 170 s. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.dark_spla: Lifestealer's charged skill: with more than 15 HP it gets Resistance IV, charges for 2.5 s, then bursts for 10 wither damage within 5.5 blocks (except Lifestealers and anyone with Wither Resistance), applying 13 s of Life Steal and knockback. The Lifestealer heals 10 HP and gets 4 s of Weakness.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.dark_ward: Saves you from a lethal hit: health is set to 10 HP and you get 5 s of Resistance IV; all monsters within 5 blocks take 10 wither damage and get 13 s of Life Steal. Ends after it triggers. Get it from the Gloomy Corridor; lasts 60 min. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.detonatio: With under 1 s left, explodes where you stand with power 3 (same as a creeper); doesn't break blocks when mobGriefing is off. Cursed Demoman Hats apply 4 s at 5 HP or less, Skeleton Demomen at 15 HP or less.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.dogtruce: Hidden hound truce: right-click a Dread Hound or Dire Hound Leader with a bone or Shattered Skull (uses 1) to apply 210 s; that hound won't attack you during it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.experienc: A mob hit by an Easter Egg gets this for 100 s; levels stack. On death it drops {=lvl} extra XP orbs worth 3 + max health × 0.35 each, plus three 1-point orbs.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.fish_brea: Out-of-water timer for Corpse Fish (15 s) and Glutton Fish (30 s). With 1 s left they get Wither II (15 s for Corpse Fish, 50 s for Glutton Fish). Back in water it clears, along with the Wither.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.gaze_of_t: Adds Darkness for the same duration, plus constant Blindness (Wither Resistance blocks the Blindness) and Magic Depletion, so magic items can't be used. Applied for 10 s by Nightmare Stalker attacks.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.infernal_: Fire damage every 2 s, less the lower your health: 5 at 30 HP or more, 3 at 6~30, 2 at 3~6, 1 at 3 or less. Water doesn't put it out; Fire Resistance makes you immune, as are pumpkin bosses and the Felsteed. Wearing the Pumpkin Lord hat applies 13 s to monsters that hit you.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.infestati: Hidden fly infestation marker: right-click a Decaying Zombie with a Corpse Maggot to apply 20 s; near the end it turns into a Swarmer.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.insect_pr: Arthropods that hit you take 6 damage back. Bloody Gadflies can't give you Myiasis, and Rotten Stink no longer attracts Corpse Flies. The anti-insect potion gives 12 min; milk removes it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.jawattack: When applied, summons 4 evoker fangs (6 damage each) under you and 1 block to the east, west and north. Applied by the Preacher's impact attack.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.lifesteal: When applied (above 2 HP), takes health directly: 2 on Hard, 1 on Normal, plus Wither I for the same duration; players also lose hunger (1.5 exhaustion). With Stranglehold as well, take 4 extra wither damage with 0.5 s left. Applied by Lifestealer attacks, Dark Splash or Vampiric Touch, usually for 13 s.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.lost_item: After Krampus or his henchmen knock items out of your hands, lasts about 1.75 s and makes dropped items within 10 blocks glow so you can find them.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.magic_dep: Out of magic: can't use magic items like the Bone Summoner's Staff, pumpkin staff, demon lantern, lord lantern or necro totem, and monsters can't cast summon skills. Lasts 15~28 s after using the Bone Summoner's Staff, 25 s for the pumpkin staff. Milk doesn't remove it; a magic bottle or Spiritual Gingerbread does.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.minion_su: Krampus's summon skill: when it kicks in, a Krampus Henchman appears 2 blocks away and the effect ends.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.rotten_sm: Every 20 s, a hostile Corpse Fly spawns 2.5 blocks from you; not while in water, in rain, or with Insect Protection. Eating Mint Candy removes it.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.sacrifice: Hidden cooldown for the dark ritual sacrifice, 1.5 s; you can't sacrifice another minion until it ends.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.snow_stor: A blizzard swirls around you: every 2 s, other mobs within 3.75 blocks (not your tamed pets, Krampus or his henchmen) get stacking Bone Chilling (max VII) and 1~4 freeze damage (more with more stacks). Water under a player's feet turns to frosted ice. The thunder caller horn gives 40 s (75 s cooldown), or 45 s (50 s cooldown) with the nightmare mask.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.stimulati: Zombie Clown's frenzy burst (1 s): every monster within 3.5 blocks, itself included, gets 20 s of Stimulation (movement speed +25%, attack speed +25%, Slowness removed). Triggers when the clown is 10+ HP below max.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.strangleh: Held in a Lifestealer's grip: without Life Steal, your speed is zeroed every tick and you get Slowness VII, so you can't move at all. With Life Steal you can move, but you take 4 extra wither damage when Life Steal ends. Applied for 18 s when a Lifestealer hits you while you already have Life Steal.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.stunning_: The Preacher winds up a ground slam (about 2 s); 1 s in, it hits: mobs within 4.5 blocks, except Preachers and undead, take 9 damage and are stunned for 2 s, then the Preacher is guard-broken for 25 s. Triggers when the Preacher is 10+ HP below max.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.sweet_mad: From eating Eternal Candy; rolls one random candy effect (5 s each): protective (Absorption, Resistance, Wither Resistance), healing (2 HP plus Regeneration), Stimulation II, Rampage, hot (Fire Resistance, Insect Protection), spooky (Vampiric Touch, Bone Barrier) or sick (Nausea, Hunger). About 17% chance nothing happens.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.undead_su: Hidden: the Preacher casting a summon, 3 s. At the end, random undead appear nearby: Door Knights, Zombie Bruisers, Decrepit Skeletons, Baby Skeletons, Siamese Skeletons, Decaying Zombies, Zombie Lumberjacks, Zombie Fishermen and so on.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.vampiric_: Melee hits on monsters (if not blocked) give the target 13 s of Life Steal; if the target isn't undead, you get 1 s of Regeneration IV. The vampiric elixir gives 6 min, Gummy Vampire Teeth give 15 s.
bufflist.desc.born_in_chaos_v1.wither_re: Immune to Wither: removes it every tick. Also blocks Dark Splash damage and Life Steal, the Blindness from Gaze of Terror, and the Nightmare Stalker's dread aura. The potion gives 8 min; a full set of Dark Metal armor also grants it.
bufflist.desc.callfromthedepth_.abyss: Hidden marker for phase 2 of the abyss boss: mobs within 75 blocks get 60 s of Abyss and Blindness, plus 60 s of Alienation, Despair, Venom and Darkness. About 20 s later, targets within 40 blocks that still have Abyss take 70 damage. Killing the matching tentacles clears those four; Abyss ends once all four are gone. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.callfromthedepth_.alientat: Hidden, one of the parts of Abyss, 60 s. Killing the Alienation tentacle clears it from every player. Abyss only ends once Alienation, Despair, Venom and Darkness are all gone.
bufflist.desc.callfromthedepth_.despair: Protective mark for the wounded ancient guardian's despair blast: the blast lands 8 s later; mobs within 25 blocks with this mark get 3 s of Regeneration IV, everyone else takes 20 damage and 3 s of Wither II. Stepping in despair fire gives 15 s, touching a despair dweller gives 9 s. Can't be combined with Venom (removes it). Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.callfromthedepth_.soul_hea: Removes Blindness and Darkness when applied, nothing else after that. Comes from the mystery stew made with light flowers and swamp Root Strands (100 s).
bufflist.desc.callfromthedepth_.venom: Protective mark for the wounded ancient guardian's venom blast: the blast lands 8 s later; mobs within 25 blocks with this mark get 3 s of Regeneration IV, everyone else takes 20 damage and 3 s of Wither II. Stepping in venom fire gives 15 s, touching a venom dweller gives 9 s. Can't be combined with Despair (removes it). Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.abyssal_burn: Take 1 abyssal burn damage about every {=2.5/2^(lvl-1)} s (the interval halves each level). After each hit there's a (75% - current health fraction) chance to be teleported randomly within 8 blocks. The Leviathan's abyss beam applies 8 s, stacking up to IV. Blessing of Amethyst removes it.
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.abyssal_curse: Take 1 abyssal burn damage about every {=2.5/2^(lvl-1)} s (the interval halves each level); the health bar turns purple. Tidal Tentacle hits apply 3 s, stacking up to V.
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.abyssal_fear: Can't heal by any means. Applied by the Leviathan's Abyss Mines (10 s) and abyss orbs (5 s). Blessing of Amethyst removes it.
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.blessing_of_amet: Removes Abyssal Burn, Abyssal Fear and Darkness every tick, so you're effectively immune to all three. Get it by eating Blessed Amethyst Crab Meat.
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.curse_of_desert: Movement controls are flipped: forward/back and left/right swap. Applied by the Ancient Remnant's sandstorm, Ancient Desert Steles (10 s) and sandstorm projectiles (5 s).
bufflist.desc.cataclysm.ghost_sickness: Given after a Cursium Chestplate revive (back to 5 HP plus 5 s of Ghost Form) ends; lasts 6 min, and the chestplate can't revive you again until then. Can't be removed by milk or anything else.
bufflist.desc.celestial_core.fear_curse: Every time you deal damage, you take {=lvl*20}% of it back (based on damage before reductions, +20% per level). Can't be removed by any means; you have to wait it out.
bufflist.desc.celestial_core.rotten_curs: After getting hurt, each second you take damage again from the last damage source: 2% of max health plus {=amp} (+1 per level, 0 at level I); the source keeps refreshing while you bleed. Can't teleport during it (ender pearls, chorus fruit, etc.). Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.celestial_core.silent: Your actions make no vibrations, so sculk sensors, the Warden and other vibration listeners can't detect you. Doesn't scale with level. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.celestial_core.unyielding: Can't die: any single hit at or above your current health is cancelled, and if you'd still die, death is cancelled and health set to 1 HP. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.celestial_core.violent: Your attacks fully ignore armor: melee, projectiles and other tracked damage you deal gets the bypass-armor tag. Doesn't scale with level. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.celestial_enchantments.des: Hurt invulnerability is reset every tick, so back-to-back hits are no longer eaten by the 0.5 s i-frames. Applied by the Destruction Crack enchantment, 5 s per level.
bufflist.desc.celestial_enchantments.sup: Can't heal at all (every heal is cancelled). Applied by the Suppression Blade enchantment, 10 s per level.
bufflist.desc.celestisynth.cursebane: All healing is divided by 1 + 2.4 × (level - 1); right now healing ×{=1/(1+amp*2.4)} ({=100-100/(1+amp*2.4)}% less; level I has no penalty). Keres's slash skills apply level II for 5 s (about -71% healing); one strong skill applies level VIII for 12.5 s (about -94%).
bufflist.desc.champions.wound: Damage taken ×1.5, healing received ×0.5. Champions with the Wound affix have a 40% chance to apply it on hit, for 10 s.
bufflist.desc.confluence.confused: Movement is fully reversed: forward/back and left/right inputs all go the other way. Wearing the Brain of Confusion applies it to nearby enemies when you're hurt, for about 4.5~15 s (longer for bigger hits).
bufflist.desc.confluence.gravitation: Press jump to flip gravity: gravity becomes ×-1, you fall toward the ceiling and the view turns 180°; press jump again to flip back. Can't switch while flying or standing on a step stool. Gravity returns to normal above the build limit or when the effect ends.
bufflist.desc.confluence.honey: Heals 1 HP per second (0.05 per tick); doesn't scale with level. Given for 5 s when you're hurt while wearing a honeycomb accessory.
bufflist.desc.confluence.paladins_shield: Level II is the Paladin's Shield wearer, level I is a teammate (the wearer refreshes 30 s on themselves and teammates every 10 s). When a player without level II gets hurt, the nearest level II player within 32 blocks with more than 25% health takes 25% of that damage for them.
bufflist.desc.eeeabsmobs.electrified_eff: Fire damage overloads it: the effect is removed, your fire goes out, and an electromagnetic blast with a 2-block radius hits nearby mobs for 8 + 5% of their max health. Not lethal to players: it can only take them down to 5% of max health (at least 1 HP).
bufflist.desc.enigmaticaddons.frozen_hea: Immune to freezing and can walk on powder snow. Melee hits add 3.5 s of freeze time to the target, and deal +30% damage to fully frozen targets.
bufflist.desc.enigmaticaddons.pure_resis: When hit, {=min(lvl*20,100)}% chance to ignore the damage completely; otherwise damage is reduced by {=min(lvl*20,100)}% (+20% per level; level V and up is full immunity).
bufflist.desc.enigmaticdelicacy.fading: Counts as invisible and your body isn't rendered; hostile mobs won't target you and piglins treat you as wearing gold. The next hit you take is fully ignored, and the next hit you deal does ×2 damage; either one ends the effect (the Scroll of Fading then has a 60 s cooldown).
bufflist.desc.enigmaticdelicacy.persever: Every time you're hurt, get 20 s of Absorption at the same level: {=lvl*4} absorption HP right now (4 per level).
bufflist.desc.enigmaticdelicacy.redempti: Only for players who ate The Forbidden Fruit: lifts its curse for now, so hunger works and you can eat normally; the healing cut on heals of 2 HP or less drops from 80% to 40%.
bufflist.desc.enigmaticdelicacy.xp_boost: XP gained ×{=1+lvl*0.5} (+50% per level); each XP pickup has a {=min(lvl,6)}/6 chance to heal 0.5 HP.
bufflist.desc.enigmaticlegacy.molten_hea: Immune to fire, burning, lava and magma blocks, and fire on you goes out right away. Clearer view in lava (about 6 blocks of fog) and no burning overlay. While wearing the Blazing Core, the duration ticks down at half speed.
bufflist.desc.farmersdelight.comfort: Natural regen keeps working at 0 saturation: heals 1 HP every 4 s, regardless of level. Doesn't kick in if saturation is above 0 or you have Regeneration.
bufflist.desc.farmersdelight.nourishment: Hunger and saturation don't drop from activity (clears up to 4 exhaustion per tick). Exception: at 18+ hunger while naturally regenerating, the cost of that regen still applies.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.chesed_darken: Chesed fight's darkening mechanic: cancels Night Vision, and with Night Vision also present forces brightness to 0. No damage by itself.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.chesed_energized: Gained by breaking Chesed's crystals (level II, 20 s): Chesed's lightning rays don't hurt you and get reflected, using up 1 level each time. Walking near a Lightning Ray Reflector activates it.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.chesed_gaze: Chesed fight's blinding mechanic: players facing away when Chesed releases darkness get this; it cancels the Night Vision given at the same time and your view goes dark. Turn to face Chesed to end it. Players with Energized aren't affected. Lasts 10 s.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.coward: Given for 3 s for leaving the arena during the Malkuth fight. Get back in to clear it; if the countdown runs out you're executed (9,000,000 damage).
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.knight: Malkuth fight arena marker: given while inside the arena, about 29 blocks around the Malkuth summoner. Leaving the arena turns it into Mark of a Coward.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.shocked: Damage dealt -25%. Applied for 10 s when a weapon with a Lightning Core fires its lightning ray.
bufflist.desc.fdbosses.sinner: Sinner mark in the Geburah fight: breaking Geburah's rules (like jumping when jumping is forbidden) adds a sin, and being more than 32 blocks from Geburah adds 1 sin every 2 s. 5 sins and you die instantly. Clears when the boss dies or you leave survival mode.
bufflist.desc.goety.acid_venom: Take 1 damage periodically: every 1.25 s at level I, 0.6 s at II, and from III about every 0.5 s (limited by hurt invulnerability). Can't take you below 1 HP. Removes and blocks Poison, also works on undead. Wearing the Wild Robe makes you immune.
bufflist.desc.goety.altruistic: When you're hurt, every ally within 60 blocks heals {=min(25*lvl,100)}% of that damage (25% per level, max 100%).
bufflist.desc.goety.arrowmantic: Flying arrows within {=2+amp} blocks turn and fly at you, at speed {=1+amp/5}.
bufflist.desc.goety.bottling: Taking brews from a cauldron gives {=lvl} extra bottles per level of liquid (never uses up the level). Stacks with the Witch Hat, Witch Robe, black cats and similar bonuses.
bufflist.desc.goety.burn_hex: Removes and blocks Fire Resistance. Wearing the Unholy Hat or Unholy Robe makes you immune and clears it at once.
bufflist.desc.goety.climbing: Climb walls like a spider at 0.2 blocks per tick when you walk into them, and cobwebs no longer slow you down.
bufflist.desc.goety.corpse_eater: Killing a mob gives n food and n×0.2 saturation (non-players heal n HP instead), where n = (2 + random 0~victim's max health/5) × {=lvl}.
bufflist.desc.goety.deflective: Projectiles that hit you have a {=25+amp*10}% chance to bounce off without hurting you.
bufflist.desc.goety.doom: When it runs out naturally, you die instantly if your health is at or below {=5*lvl}% of max (5% per level). Bosses aren't affected.
bufflist.desc.goety.electrified: Every 4 s, zaps up to 2 visible non-allied mobs within 4 blocks for {=4*lvl} damage each with knockback; each hit has a 5% chance to add 5 s of Spasms (30% in a thunderstorm if the target is in the rain).
bufflist.desc.goety.ender_flux: Every time you're hurt, you teleport randomly within about ±{=8+amp} blocks horizontally and vertically, with a 5% chance to leave an endermite behind.
bufflist.desc.goety.ender_ground: Can't teleport in any way (ender pearls, chorus fruit, enderman-style random teleports, teleport spells, etc.); commands still work. Removes Shadow Walk when applied.
bufflist.desc.goety.evil_eye: While fewer than 16 monsters are within 16 blocks, spawns a hostile mob native to the biome within 16 blocks about every {=3.2/2^amp} s. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goety.explosive: When hurt, {=100/max(1,5-lvl)}% chance to explode with power {=3+lvl/2} (breaks blocks); being pushed by other entities also has a {=100/max(1,100-10*lvl)}% chance per tick. The effect is removed after it goes off.
bufflist.desc.goety.fiery_aura: Keeps setting non-allied mobs within {=lvl+1} blocks on fire for {=5*lvl} s (if they aren't burning and lack Fire Resistance).
bufflist.desc.goety.fire_trail: Walking on the ground sets fire to the empty spaces you pass through (needs a solid block below, not in liquid).
bufflist.desc.goety.fortunate: Fortune +{=lvl} for ore, crop and other Fortune-affected drops. Doesn't affect Looting.
bufflist.desc.goety.freezing: Like standing in powder snow: freeze builds by {=4*lvl} per tick (thaws 2 per tick), so you're fully frozen after about {=7/(4*lvl-2)} s, then take vanilla freeze damage and slow down. No effect with any leather armor piece, on freeze-immune mobs, or with Snow Skin.
bufflist.desc.goety.frog_leg: Jump {=lvl} extra times in midair (+1 per level), at least 0.2 s between air jumps.
bufflist.desc.goety.frosty_aura: Keeps giving non-allied mobs within {=lvl+1} blocks Freezing {=lvl} for 5 s.
bufflist.desc.goety.gold_touched: Mobs drop {=lvl}~{=3*lvl} extra gold nuggets on death (1~3 per level; needs doMobLoot).
bufflist.desc.goety.illague: Every {=30/2^amp} s (not on Peaceful), you get a random one of Weakness, Hunger, Nausea, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Poison, Erode, Freezing, Flammable or Flimsy at a random level 1~{=lvl}, lasting 20 s × that level. Non-undead mobs within 8 blocks have a 5% chance every 5 s to catch it (at half the remaining time). Villagers that die with it become zombie villagers; illagers and other raiders are immune.
bufflist.desc.goety.impaired: Can't break or place blocks (except in creative), and mobs can't wreck terrain either (creeper explosions don't destroy blocks).
bufflist.desc.goety.insight: XP dropped by mobs that players kill ×{=2*lvl}.
bufflist.desc.goety.necrosis: Undead heal 1 HP every 2.5 s; everything else takes 1 rot damage every 1.25 s (can kill). With the Necro Crown + Necro Cape it becomes Weakness instead; with the Nameless Crown + Nameless Cape it does nothing. Doesn't scale with level.
bufflist.desc.goety.nyctophobia: In darkness (light level 4 or lower) or with Darkness, take 1 damage periodically: every 2 s at level I, 1 s at II, about 0.5 s from III. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goety.photosynthesis: In daylight under open sky, not in rain or water, heal 1 HP every {=2.5/2^amp} s.
bufflist.desc.goety.plunge: More than 4 blocks off the ground, you fall an extra {=0.2+amp/10} blocks per tick; in liquids you sink {=0.05+amp/100} per tick and can't swim. Non-creative players can't fly. No effect with Levitation.
bufflist.desc.goety.pressure: When 3 or more mobs (yourself included) in line of sight are within {=8+amp} blocks, take 1 damage periodically: every 2 s at level I, 1 s at II, about 0.5 s from III. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goety.repulsive: Knocks back mobs that attack you, horizontal strength {=1+amp/2}, vertical {=0.4+amp*0.2}.
bufflist.desc.goety.save_effects: When a player dies, all their effects are saved and given back on respawn with the same time left (except Save Effects itself).
bufflist.desc.goety.sense_loss: Players get Blindness of the same level and duration instead. Mobs detect targets at only {=max(0,50-amp*10)}% of their normal range and lose their current target when it's applied.
bufflist.desc.goety.shadow_walk: True invisibility: normal mobs can't target you and bosses only see you at half range. Your next attack deals ×{=1.25+amp/4} damage. Attacking, shooting, casting, using non-staff items, interacting with entities or blocks, breaking or placing blocks, or changing dimension ends it immediately.
bufflist.desc.goety.shielded: Damage taken -{=5*lvl}% (5% per level); some special damage types aren't reduced.
bufflist.desc.goety.shielding: You and allies within 8 blocks get Shielded of the same level: damage taken -{=5*lvl}% (5% per level).
bufflist.desc.goety.snow_skin: Like a snow golem: keep taking burn damage in hot biomes, water and rain hurt you, you're immune to freezing and powder snow, and you leave snow where you walk. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goety.spasms: Take 1 shock damage and get shoved in a random direction periodically: every 2 s at level I, 1 s at II, about 0.5 s from III (limited by i-frames). Can't take you below 1 HP.
bufflist.desc.goety.storms_wrath: While you can see the sky, {=10+amp*10}% chance every {=1/2^amp} s to be struck by lightning; +10% if it's raining where you are, +25% more in a thunderstorm.
bufflist.desc.goety.summon_down: Summon spells cost ×{=lvl+1} soul energy. Servants summoned now have half health, permanent Weakness {=lvl} and Erode {=lvl+4} (+{=(lvl+4)*20}% damage taken), and nearly broken gear. Each summon during the cooldown raises the level by 1 (max V) and refreshes the duration.
bufflist.desc.goety.sun_allergy: Catch fire for 8 s in sunlight like undead. With a helmet on, the helmet loses 0~1 durability each time instead and breaks when it runs out. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goety.swirling: Melee hits whip up a whirlwind that deals {=5+amp*2.5} damage to non-allied mobs within 4 blocks horizontally and 1 vertically, other than the target.
bufflist.desc.goety.tremor_sense: While both you and they are on the ground, mobs within {=16*lvl} blocks show a glowing outline to you (+16 blocks per level).
bufflist.desc.goety.tripping: While moving on the ground, {=25+amp*10}% chance every {=1/2^amp} s to get shoved in a random direction.
bufflist.desc.goety.void_touched: The next damage you take is ×{=lvl+1}, then the effect is removed. Void damage doesn't trigger it; the Void Robe and some mobs are immune.
bufflist.desc.goety.wild_rage: The mob attacks the nearest creature within follow range (4 blocks vertically), friend or foe. Its target is cleared when the effect ends.
bufflist.desc.goety.wounded: Illager servants revived by the Ominous Idol get this for 1 in-game day (20 min) plus 5 min of Crippled. If they go down again during it they can't be revived. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.berserk: Attack speed ×{=1+lvl} (+100% per level), movement speed +{=lvl*0.05} (player base is 0.1, so about +50% per level). When it ends without a Mushroom Hat on, you get Blindness, Weakness and Nausea of the same level for 30 s each.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.chains: Hits have a 30% chance to entangle up to 2 other attackable mobs nearby (8 blocks horizontal, 4 vertical) so they can't move, for {=lvl-1} s. Level I lasts 0 s, so it does nothing.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.committed: More damage the more health the target has lost: damage ×(1 + missing health fraction × {=lvl*25}%), up to +{=lvl*25}% on a nearly dead target (+25% per level).
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.critical_hit: {=lvl*5}% chance to crit for ×3 damage (+5% chance per level).
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.echo: Melee or arrow hits leave an echo on the target that bursts 1 s later, dealing {=lvl*20}% of that hit's damage to mobs within 3 blocks (+20% per level; full damage within about 1.9 blocks, less further out). Ignores hurt invulnerability.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.enchantment_sh: Damage you deal +{=lvl*(lvl+19)/2}% (10% at I, 21% at II, 33% at III), for both melee and projectiles.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.enchantment_th: When a mob hits you, {=lvl*10}% of that damage (before armor) is reflected to the attacker as thorns damage (+10% per level).
Hits have a {=(lvl-1)*10}% chance to summon a Magic Lightning Trap at a random spot within 3 blocks of the target, dealing your attack damage in a 1.5-block radius for 2 s. 0% at level I.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.frenzied: Below 50% health, attack speed and movement speed ×{=1+lvl*0.1} (+10% per level); the bonus goes away once you're back above half.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.mob_resurrecti: Does nothing right now: the effect class is empty and nothing in the code reads it.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.mucilage_posse: Armor -{=lvl*8}, armor toughness -{=lvl*4} (-8 / -4 per level), and you glow through walls.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.multi_shot: Does nothing right now: the effect class is empty and nothing in the code reads it.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.potent_venom: No damage while it lasts; when it ends, take {=3*lvl^2} magic damage (3 at I, 12 at II, 27 at III). From level II it then drops one level and lasts another 5 s, resolving each step. Getting hit with it again while poisoned has a 25% chance to raise the level (max III); otherwise the timer doesn't refresh.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.rampaging: Kills have a 10% chance to give attack speed ×1.5 for {=lvl*5} s (+5 s per level).
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.recover: Every heal restores {=lvl} extra HP (+1 per level), from any source, natural regen included.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.shockwave: Hits have a {=(lvl-1)*10}% chance to fire a Razor Wind at the nearest enemy within 16 blocks (or straight ahead if none), dealing your attack damage and flying for 2 s. 0% at level I.
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.visual_disturb: Damage you deal has a {=lvl*10}% chance to become 0 (+10% per level).
bufflist.desc.goetyawaken.weakening_hand: Hits give the target Weakness of the same level for {=lvl*5} s (+5 s per level).
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.crimson_memor: Immune to all attacks in the Nether. Player melee hits also deal Doom damage equal to 10× the target's max health (Annihilation damage if the target is in the Nether). Doesn't work on the Apostle, Heretic, Wither Necromancer or Maverick.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.hunting_denia: Like always being protected by a Shrieking Obelisk: high soul energy won't send illager hunting parties after you.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.hydration: In water or rain, heal 1 HP every {=2.5/2^(lvl-1)} s (2.5 s at level I, interval halves each level).
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.servant_reinf: Goety summon spells summon one extra time, the summon cooldown is cleared, and the spell's soul energy is refunded.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.the_pale_mess: Immune to newly applied negative effects, damage taken halved (×0.5). Player melee hits summon hellfire under the target, dealing 2 hellfire damage to non-allied mobs.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.void_affix: Each swing that hits deals {=lvl} extra void damage to the target (+1 per level), regardless of attack cooldown.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.warden: Sense vibrations within 16 blocks; mobs that make them are marked for 5 s and take ×1.5 damage from you.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.wight_denial: High soul energy no longer makes Wights spawn around you.
bufflist.desc.goetydelight.zombified_pig: When hurt, 50% chance to summon a Zombified Piglin Brute Servant (lasts 180 s, 1% chance to come in full armor). Each summon takes 60 s off this effect; if there isn't enough left, the effect ends.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.abyssal_s: Every hit you take, projectiles included, is dodged completely and you slide about 1 block left or right, with no limit. Fall damage, damage that bypasses invulnerability and damage tagged to bypass evasion still hit. Only works on players and Iron's Spells casting mobs.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.airborne: While knocked into the air, hitting a wall at more than 2 blocks/s horizontally deals {=4+lvl*0.5} damage (+0.5 per level), then the effect is removed. Comes from spells like Gust and Telekinesis.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.angel_win: Glide as if wearing an elytra without one (jump in midair to open). From the Angel Wings spell it lasts 10 s × spell level (boosted by spell power).
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.burning_d: Burning Dash's dash state, about 0.75 s: mobs you touch take {=amp} fire spell damage and burn for 4 s, and you take no fall damage. Ends early if you hit a wall without touching a mob.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.echoing_s: Non-spell melee or arrow hits spawn an Ender Echo that chases the same target: melee makes a spectral claymore (2-block explosion), arrows make a homing Magic Arrow. Echo damage = original damage × {=lvl*5}% × spell power × ender spell power, and ignores i-frames. Removed when its charges run out. The Echoing Strikes spell applies level 15 (75%) with spell level + 2 echoes.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.evasion: Cancels a hit and teleports you to a safe spot about 6 blocks behind; dodges {=lvl} times, then the effect is removed. Fall damage, damage that bypasses invulnerability (like /kill) and damage tagged to bypass evasion can't be dodged. Only works on players and Iron's Spells casting mobs. With the Amulet of Teleportation, each spell teleport gives 3 s of Evasion I.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.fall_dama: Fall distance is reset every tick, so no fall damage while it lasts. Applied by spells like Shadow Slash.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.fortify: Gives {=lvl} absorption HP right away and takes those {=lvl} back when it ends. The Fortify spell applies it to allies within 8 blocks for 120 s.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.frostbite: Killing a fully frozen mob turns it into an ice statue that shatters after 5 s or when hit: 8 icicles fly out, each dealing {=lvl} × ice spell power damage, and enemies within about 2 blocks take half that.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.gluttony: Eating restores mana based on the food's hunger value: {=(lvl+3)*0.5} mana per hunger point (+0.5 per level), and you can keep eating at full hunger.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.guided: The target glows. New projectiles fired within 48 blocks whose path passes within about 3.5~5.5 blocks of it (bigger targets, wider range) curve to home in on it. Applied by Guiding Bolt hits.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.immolate: Each stack lasts 15 s; at 3 stacks it explodes and is removed, dealing 10 × caster's spell power × fire spell power fire magic damage to everything within 6 blocks (falls off with distance, ignores i-frames), and everything hit gets a stack of Immolation. Stacked by fire spells cast in the Infernal Sorcerer Chestplate and by Ominous Fire Orbs.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.planar_si: All mobs within 18 blocks of height difference get a purple glowing outline you can see through walls; your view is tinted with purple fog (about 160 blocks of visibility), and you can read the Ruined Book. The Planar Sight spell lasts 40/60/80 s.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.sacrifici: When a marked mob dies it bursts in a blood explosion, dealing (11 + {=lvl}) × spell power × the summoner's summon damage within about 3 blocks (highest at the center), and the body vanishes. Servants summoned by the ominous Dead King get it at random.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.trial_ome: Getting near a trial spawner turns it ominous, and the Dead King or Tyros echo spawned within 24 blocks become their ominous versions. A triggered Bad Omen turns into this, 15 min per Bad Omen level.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.true_invi: Fully invisible, armor and held items included; mobs can't target you, and mobs within 40 blocks chasing you lose track when it's applied. Ends the moment you damage anything.
bufflist.desc.irons_spellbooks.volt_stri: Volt Strike's dash state, about 0.5 s: mobs you run into take {=amp} lightning spell damage; hitting a mob or block discharges within 4 blocks for up to {=amp*0.5} damage (less with distance) and bounces you back. No fall damage during it.
bufflist.desc.kubejs.undead_blood: With a player within 16 blocks, heals 2% of max health every 2 s. The modpack gives this permanently to undead bosses.
bufflist.desc.l2artifacts.frost_shield: Thermal set 4-piece bonus: damage taken -{=10+lvl*10}% (scales with set level: 20% at level 1, +10% per level), only while you're still wearing the set. Freeze damage is cancelled and gives you 3 s of this. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.l2artifacts.thermal_motive: Thermal set 2-piece bonus: damage dealt +{=10+lvl*10}% (scales with set level: 20% at level 1, +10% per level), only while you're still wearing the set. Fire damage is cancelled and gives you 3 s of this. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.l2complements.cleanse: When applied and every 0.5 s after, removes all your effects (good ones too) and blocks new ones. Skill-type effects like set bonuses aren't affected.
bufflist.desc.l2complements.curse: Can't heal (every heal is cancelled). The Cursed Blade enchantment applies 5 s, doubling per level.
bufflist.desc.l2complements.emerald_spla: Every 0.5 s, hostile mobs within {=lvl*10} blocks take 50% of your attack damage (rounded) and slight knockback; radius +10 blocks per level. Doesn't hurt allies, and skips targets still in hit stun.
bufflist.desc.l2complements.flame: Take {=2^lvl} soul fire damage per second (2 at level I, doubling each level), ignoring armor. Soul Flame Blade hits apply 3 s, Soul Flame Thorn counters apply 5 s, Soul Fire Charges apply 3 s.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.bleedin: Bleeding damage every 1.5 s: 50% chance of 2, 12.5% chance of 3, otherwise 1 (about 1.75 on average). Level doesn't matter. Applied by the Fallen Paladin, gold-forged halberd, soul greatsword, Spiked Shield and others.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.chorus_: Each tick, 5% chance to take 3 magic damage and teleport to a random spot within about 2 blocks (about once a second on average). Level doesn't matter. Applied by chorus spirits, chorus envoys, the chorus blade, infected chorus fruit and others.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.curse_o: The screen turns upside down (camera rotated 180°); no damage by itself. Applied for 8 s by the overloaded creeper.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.fear: Applied to mobs within 16 blocks when the skeletal dragon roars (7~12 s). The code gives it no actual effect; it's just a marker.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.freeze: Freeze is locked at max, so you keep taking vanilla freeze damage (1 every 2 s, 5 for cold-sensitive mobs) and are slowed, plus a 5% chance each tick of 2 extra freeze damage. Freeze resets to 0 when it ends. Level doesn't matter. Applied by frost golems, the giant frost, the frost shield and others.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.low_att: Players only: base entity reach (attack range) drops from 3 to 2 blocks, back to 3 when it ends. Holding the sharp hairpin gives it constantly, and getting hit by one has an 80% chance to give 2 s.
bufflist.desc.legendary_monsters.unbreak: Players only: immune to all damage. Triggers when wearing the annihilator chestplate and dropping below 50% health, for 4 s (20 s cooldown); it also deals 15 damage to mobs within 5 blocks and sets them on fire for 3 s.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.eclipsed: Stores and removes all your other effects when applied, and you can't gain new ones. When Eclipse ends or is removed, the stored effects come back with the same time left. Applied by the Paw of the New Moon.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.fragility: Damage taken +{=lvl*20}% (+20% per level). Applied by the Paw of the Crescent Moon.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.frozen: Frozen in a block of ice: can't move (Slowness LI), attack, use items or interact, and mob AI stops. Fire damage thaws you right away, and so does a lethal hit (before it lands). Applied by Ice Crystals and the Frostmaw, 2.5 s by default.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.geomancy: Given automatically while holding the Earthrend Gauntlet in either hand. Right-click dirt or stone (empty hand or gauntlet) to raise a boulder, hold to charge a bigger one, then punch it to launch it for 10 / 14 / 18 / 25 damage by size. Sprint to roll a boulder into enemies; double-tap in midair and hold sneak to tunnel through the ground.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.moons_curse: Night-form marker for the Elokosa Howler: applied every night except during a new moon, switching it to its night form. Nothing else.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.poison_resist: Immune to poison: clears any Poison when applied, and Poison can't be applied while it lasts.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.sunblock: Shield cast by Umvuthana Cranes: heals 1 HP every {=2.5/2^(lvl-1)} s (when hurt). Umvuthi, the Sunbird is immune to almost all damage with it, and anything that attacks it switches to attacking Cranes within 40 blocks.
bufflist.desc.mowziesmobs.suns_blessing: Empty-hand right-click: call a sunstrike (3-block radius, 2 normal + 2 fire damage). Sneak + empty-hand right-click: fire the solar beam (about 2.75 s, 1.125 normal + 0.75 fire damage per hit), costing 5 min of this effect. Sneak + left-click: Solar Flare. Sneak + hold both buttons: Supernova (3.2 normal + 3.2 fire damage), costing 60 min. A permanent one becomes 60 min after your first cast.
bufflist.desc.obscure_api.knowledge: Shows hidden "knowledge" text in the tooltips of some Obscuria mods' items. No stat effect. Drinking a Vial of Knowledge gives 120 s.
bufflist.desc.ramesses_curse.blood_forfe: Given after being killed by an enemy with the Blood Forfeit affix: max health -2 (never below 2), stacks and refreshes, wears off after 5 min. Learning that affix's knowledge makes you immune.
bufflist.desc.ramesses_curse.drought: Applied constantly in the Duat desert dimension: attack damage -3, armor -3; leaving the dimension ends it. Eating dates gives 10 s of drought immunity.
bufflist.desc.ramesses_curse.flight_fall: Given when an enemy with the Flight Fall affix hits you while flying: you lose flight and get dragged down for 5 s, then can fly again. Learning that affix's knowledge makes you immune.
bufflist.desc.ramesses_curse.inversion: Controls are flipped: forward/back and left/right reverse, and jump swaps with sneak. Applied constantly while holding a Duat ember; paused during hurt invulnerability.
bufflist.desc.ramesses_curse.pitchfire_l: Walk on top of lava, and you float back up if you fall in. Get it by eating pitchfire crystal; lasts 60 s (along with Fire Resistance I and Speed II).
bufflist.desc.relics.anti_heal: Can't heal at all; every heal is cancelled.
bufflist.desc.relics.bleeding: Take 5% of current health as damage every second, max 10 per hit, regardless of level. Applied by the Rage Glove and others.
bufflist.desc.relics.confusion: Forward/back and left/right movement are reversed.
bufflist.desc.relics.paralysis: Can't move, jump or sneak (movement input is zeroed), but you can still look around and attack.
bufflist.desc.relics.stun: Completely stunned: can't move, jump, look around, attack or use items; every key except Esc is disabled. Stars circle your head.
bufflist.desc.relics.vanishing: Your body isn't rendered (not even your hand when empty), and mobs don't see you as a visible target.
bufflist.desc.revelationfix.quietus: Armor and Protection enchantments block {=lvl*10}% less, healing received -{=lvl*10}%. Four stages: level I also gives Wither III, then turns into level II for 10 s; level II halves max health, and if you're wearing the Nether Robe when it ends it becomes level III for 10 s; when level III ends you take 20% of max health as damage and explode (no block damage), spreading to mobs within 8 blocks if the caster has a halo, then it becomes level IV for 10 s; level IV deals 4% of max health as annihilation damage every second, ignoring i-frames. Dying with it summons a Wither Skeleton Servant for the caster (lasts 300 s).
bufflist.desc.royalvariations.pressing_g: Endermen within 16 blocks target you, and the royal enderman's sweep attacks and shadow anvils also hit mobs with this (4~8 damage). The first time it's applied you also get 4 s of Darkness. Given for 20 s when a royal enderman hits you.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.adrenaline: The lower your health, the faster you move: movement speed ×(1 + missing health fraction × {=lvl}), e.g. +50% at half health on level I. Updates every tick.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.berserk: The lower your health, the harder you hit: attack damage ×(1 + missing health fraction × {=lvl}), e.g. +50% at half health on level I. Updates every tick.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.bleeding: Can't heal at all; no healing works (potions, natural regen, lifesteal).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.blood_clot: No natural regen from food; potions and other healing still work. Players only.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.brimstone_vision: See clearly in lava; removes the fog inside it.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.burning_thorns: Every hit from a source sets the attacker on fire for {=lvl+4} s (+1 s per level).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.caffeinated: A small boost to everything: movement speed, jump strength, max health, armor, luck and attack damage (per-level values in the attributes below).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.caffeine_crash: The crash after the caffeine wears off: movement speed, jump strength, max health, armor, luck and attack damage all go down (per-level values in the attributes below).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.chronos: Freezes the time left on all your other effects. Each extra effect makes this one tick down faster (with N other effects it uses N ticks per tick).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.confusion: Forces reduced debug info, so the F3 screen no longer shows coordinates and other details. Players only.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.creative_shock: Outside creative, take {=lvl+1} damage for each block you place (+1 per level).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.heartbreak: Lowers max health (value in the attributes below); current health is cut down to the new max right away.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.lava_walking: Stand and walk on lava; sneak to sink in.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.perception: Other mobs within about {=7+lvl} blocks keep glowing (+1 block per level).
bufflist.desc.runiclib.pyromaniac: Immune to all fire damage. Standing in fire or soul fire while hurt heals {=lvl} HP every 1.5 s.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.retaliation: Every hit from a source deals {=lvl+1} damage back to the attacker (+1 per level), even if i-frames blocked the hit.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.tempus: Speeds up your other effects: each tick they lose {=lvl} extra ticks, so {=lvl+1}× speed. Side effect: sped-up effects are reset to level I. With Chronos present, it speeds up Chronos itself instead.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.trail_blazing: While not sneaking, places fire in your block if it's air, leaving a trail of flames. Immune to all fire damage while it lasts.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.traversal: Instant: teleports you to your spawn point (bed or respawn anchor), or world spawn if that's invalid. Players only; doesn't change dimension.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.venom: Take {=lvl} venom damage every 2 s (+1 per level). Unlike Poison, it can kill.
bufflist.desc.runiclib.water_walking: Stand and walk on water; sneak to sink in.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.astral_shift: Players only: all damage taken is cancelled, and each hit adds max(1, damage ÷ 10) levels (max C). With 0.5 s left it bursts, dealing {=amp} damage to enemies within 8 blocks (±1 vertically; +1 per absorbed level, max 300, no knockback). Right-click with Caelestis to get it for 5 s, along with Darkness and Slowness I.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.battle_fatigu: Nether-infused Banner cooldown marker after summoning a banner, 40 s; hits won't summon another banner until it ends. Nothing else, and the banner doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.echo: Bursts once within 1 s, dealing {=2+amp} magic damage (2 base, +1 per level, ignores i-frames), then it's removed. Applied by Nether-infused Echo hits (level III with two-handed weapons); the Fatal Flicker dash applies higher levels based on nearby enemies.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.elemental_vor: An elemental vortex swirls around you: every 0.5 s nearby enemies take {=3+amp/2} damage (3 base, +0.5 per level, ignores i-frames); radius is 1 block, +1 every 6 levels. Get it by right-clicking with Tempest to absorb fire/ice vortexes from enemies; level is the sum of both (max XXXI), lasts 60 s.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.fatal_flicker: Whisperwind skill (0.6 s): while 0.25 s or more remain, dash where you're looking at 3× speed every tick, get 0.5 s of Resistance IV and about 1.25 s of i-frames, give enemies within 3 blocks Echo (higher with more enemies in range, max C) and pull enemies within 6 blocks toward you. Hard stop for the last 0.25 s. Apotheosis's Fatal Flicker affix also applies it on attack.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.flameseed: A seed of fire planted by Flamewind, about 5 s: take 5 + remaining spreads damage every second (about 11 at first). In the last second it detonates, dealing 15 damage to other mobs within 3 blocks and spreading the seed to them (spreads -1, starts at 6); the carrier takes 15 + remaining spreads damage. If the caster is within 30 blocks, each detonation gives them a level of Haste (6 s, max XI).
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.freeze: Frozen in place: position is locked and velocity zeroed every tick, so you can't move. Frost Ward rune hits have about a 15% chance to apply 6 s (always with 18 s of Slowness II); Ice Block, Leviathan, Soul Pyre and other weapon skills apply it too.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.immolation: Players only: every 0.75 s, nearby enemies take damage equal to 1/3 of your current health (ignores i-frames) and burn for 1 s; horizontal radius {=amp} blocks (vertical is a third of that). Turning on the Immolation rune with right-click gives level I (barely reaches anything not touching you); Nether-infused Radiance gives level V for 10 s on hitting a target with Weakness. Ends at once if you're not holding a sword with either ability.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.magislam: Magispear leap: jump forward and up for the first 0.1 s, get forced down after about 0.6 s, and on landing deal 2× main-hand attack damage to enemies within 4 blocks and launch them; then this and Resilience are removed. Lasts 3.1 s, with Resilience IV blocking hits meanwhile.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.magistorm: While holding the Magiscythe in your main hand, every {=max(3,10-amp)/20} s it strikes a random mob within 4 blocks (±1 vertically) for 3 damage (no knockback, ignores i-frames). Each strike has a 5% chance to add a level (max XI) and refresh to 20 s. Magiscythe hits during it have a 25% chance per equipped/held item to repair durability equal to the weapon's attack damage. Right-click the Magiscythe for level II, 20 s.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.onslaught: Players only: every 2 s, get 0.5 s of Haste XVI (much faster attacks). Near the end it removes Haste and gives 4 s of Weakness I. Nether-infused Onslaught gives 4 s when you hit a target with Slowness (not while you have Weakness); Molten Edge gives it based on nearby enemies.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.pain: Take {=lvl*0.5} damage every 0.75 s (1 tick shorter per 8 levels), no knockback, ignores i-frames. Stacked by Spore Swarm or by banners summoned by Enigma (max L); each application adds 1 level and refreshes to 3 s.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.resilience: Players only: every hit you take is fully cancelled and uses up 1 level; the effect ends when levels run out (blocks {=lvl} hits). The Magispear leap gives level IV for 3.2 s; the Ribboncleaver dash gives level II for 0.75 s.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.smouldering: Each Emberlash hit adds 1 level and refreshes to 5 s, max VII. Getting hit by Emberlash while you have it deals extra damage equal to {=15*amp}% of the weapon's attack damage (+15% per level, none at I).
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.spore_swarm: Spores swirl around you: every 0.75 s, enemies within {=1+amp*0.5} blocks (±1 vertically) get stacking Slowness (max IV), Mining Fatigue (max III) and Pain (max L; LXXV when dual-wielding Bramblethorn, X without it). Each enemy hit adds a level to you (max V) and refreshes to 10 s. Bramblethorn hits have about a 45% chance to give level III.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.storm: Mjolnir hits have about a 15% chance to apply it, for just 2 ticks: hostile mobs within 10 blocks horizontally and 5 vertically of the target that are in rain or water and at least 5 blocks from the attacker each get struck by lightning.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.void_assault: Applied by Dreadtide's void summon (12.5 s): take Dreadtide attack damage × 1 + {=amp} damage every {=max(1,12-2*amp)/20} s (ignores i-frames). The level comes from the caster's Void Cloak stacks; more stacks, faster ticks.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.ward: Players only: every second, get 1 s of Absorption at level = current health ÷ 4 (rounded), about current health + 4 absorption. From right-clicking the Ward rune, at the cost of half your current health; lasts 6 s, 6 s cooldown.
bufflist.desc.simplyswords.wildfire: Every tick, sets mobs of the same type within 10 blocks horizontally and 5 vertically on fire for 9 s (not the attacker's allies), only if the last attacker was a player. From the Wildfire rune, about a 10% chance on hit, lasts 9 s.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.blade_dance: Each Glaive of Hodir hit adds a level (max V), lasts 8 s; each level gives the glaive +0.8 attack damage and +0.1 attack speed (now +{=0.8*lvl} / +{=0.1*lvl}). Every hit you take removes a level. Reaching V gives 11 s of Resistance II and Absorption III (then a 10 s cooldown); at max stacks every 3rd hit also deals glaive damage within 2 blocks.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.bleed: Take {=lvl} bleed damage every {=0.75/2^amp} s (every 0.75 s at level I, about halving each level). Undead and skeleton mobs are immune. Applied by the empowered Skofnung, the Whirligig Sawblade and Old Champion's Remains.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.blight: Armor works against you: with any armor, damage taken goes up by ln(level) × armor ÷ 60, e.g. about +37% at level III with 20 armor (no effect at level I). Night's Edge hits apply it and raise the level each time; the Featherlight skill applies level V.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.bloodthirsty: Take 1 damage every {=2/2^amp} s; attacking with a tool or weapon heals {=2+amp} HP (scaled by attack charge). The Heap of Raw Iron skill gives 10 s along with Strength I; level goes up with damage enchantments.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.calculated_fa: Your next fall does no damage and becomes a ground slam instead: nearby mobs take {=amp} + fall height × 0.2 damage (max 100), with range growing with height, and get launched based on height. The Comet Spear skill gives level XI, The Darkin Blade gives level XIII (landing also heals you); lasts 30 s.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.chungus_tonic: On non-player mobs: they instantly turn into a random mob from a whitelist (which can despawn). On players: Moderately Sized Chunguses (when not angry) won't attack you, and you can't be fed another Chungus Tonic. Comes from the Chungus Tonic (50 s); having a Chungus Staff in your inventory refreshes 6 s every 5 s.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.cooldown: Shared weapon skill cooldown marker; the skill can't be used again while it's on. Duration depends on the skill: e.g. the Dark Moon Greatsword's Frost Moon 35 s, the Chungus Staff 120 s, The Darkin Scythe's shadow dive, the Glaive of Hodir's max-stack buff 10 s. Enchantments can shorten some cooldowns.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.decay: Damage taken +{=20*lvl}% (+20% per level). Players lose {=lvl} durability on every armor piece every {=max(10-2*amp,1)/20} s (except the Cape of Chaos). Wearing the Crown of Chaos or Helm of Chaos negates both and instead gives 2.5 s of Regeneration at the same level.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.disable_heal: Can't heal by any means. Applied by Skofnung hits, Fallen Icon attacks and the tainted holy food potion.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.fear: Non-boss mobs drop their target and run to a random spot within 25 blocks every {=0.5/2^amp} s. The Dawnbreaker burst applies 4 s to enemies within 10 blocks.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.freezing: Forced into the in-powder-snow freezing state, with freeze rising an extra {=amp} per tick; once fully frozen you keep taking vanilla freeze damage. Dying with it causes an ice burst that deals {=lvl*1.5} damage to non-player mobs within 1 block and spreads 10 s of Permafrost at the same level. No effect on freeze-immune mobs or with Frost Moon.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.frost_moon: Clears your freeze every tick; immune to powder snow freezing and Permafrost. Also required to use the Dark Moon Greatsword's right-click ranged skill. The Frost Moon skill gives 20 s, 35 s cooldown (enchantments shorten it, min 15 s).
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.ghostly: State while The Darkin Scythe's shadow dive possesses a target (up to 4 s): invisible model, immune to all damage, can't attack. On leaving, deals 20 + 10% of the target's max health and heals you for 25% of that.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.hallowed_drag: Every {=2.5/2^amp} s: players and their tamed mobs heal {=lvl} HP, everything else takes {=2+amp} damage. The Dragon Staff's Dragon Breath Cloud applies level II.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.life_leach: Checks every {=2/2^amp} s: if the last target you hit has Wither, Poison or Bleed, you heal 1 HP. Wearing the Hallowheart / Infused Hallowheart, mobs that hit you also take 1 damage, get knocked back and get 5 s of Wither I (the Infused one also burns them for 6 s). Given by the Hallowheart skill for 20 s.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.magic_resista: Magic damage taken (indirect magic too) -{=min(100,20*lvl)}% (20% per level). From the Potion of Magical Warding; a full Dark Sorcerer set gives level II constantly.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.moon_herald: Right-click the Lunar Ring for 30 s (level goes up with Unbreaking): pressing attack fires moonlight slashes (3 + {=2*amp} damage, about one every 0.25 s), moonlight weapons that need charging work without it, and the Holy Moonlight Greatsword's skill cooldown is {=amp} s shorter.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.posture_break: Posture broken: every {=0.5/2^amp} s you get 1 s of Slowness IV, Weakness X and Mining Fatigue X. The next non-projectile hit you take deals +{=3*lvl} (players) or +{=8*lvl} (other mobs), then the effect is removed. A perfect shield block gives the attacker level I for 3 s; filling 200 posture damage (from Soulslike Weaponry guns, throw skills, etc.) gives level II for 3 s.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.retribution: Dawnbreaker / Genesis Fracture hits on undead apply it and add a level each time, lasting 4 s (starting level goes up with Fire Aspect). When an undead with it dies, {=100-100*0.75^amp}% chance of a Dawnbreaker burst: 10 damage (+5 per Fire Aspect level) to undead within 10 blocks, sets them on fire and gives 4 s of Undead Fear.
bufflist.desc.soulsweapons.veil_of_fire: Every {=1.5/2^amp} s, deals {=2+amp} fire damage to every mob within 1.5 blocks (yourself included) and sets them on fire for {=2+amp} s; you also get 3 s of Fire Resistance and burn for 3 s (not creative players). Given by the Genesis Fracture skill for 10 s; level goes up with damage enchantments.
bufflist.desc.terramity.ability_cooldown: Accessory active ability on cooldown; can't trigger again until it ends. E.g. All-Seeing Scarf 120 s base, revive accessories 60 s. The Prismatic Ring shortens it.
bufflist.desc.terramity.aimbot: While wearing Cyber Glasses, your view locks onto the nearest mob within 7 blocks. Ends if you take them off; the glasses can toggle it.
bufflist.desc.terramity.armor_set_abilit: Armor set ability (keybind) on cooldown; can't use it again until it ends.
bufflist.desc.terramity.dash_cooldown: Dash (Sarashi accessories) on cooldown; can't dash again until it ends. 3.5 s base; the Agility Ring and others shorten it.
bufflist.desc.terramity.divergency: Every hit you deal is followed 1 s later by the same amount of divergency damage to the same target (max 20, ignores i-frames).
bufflist.desc.terramity.divine_flight: Free flight like creative. Removed above Y=320. With the Hubris of Icarus on, if the sky is open above you when it ends, lightning kills you (5000 damage).
bufflist.desc.terramity.dizzy: Also gives Nausea for the same duration, so the screen warps and sways. Immunity removes it.
bufflist.desc.terramity.dripleaf_step: Walk on air: temporary big dripleaves appear under you over air, grass or snow layers (gone after 1 s). Ends at once if you're not wearing any Virentium samurai armor.
bufflist.desc.terramity.electric_shock_e: Take 2 shock damage every 0.5 s (4 per second) until it ends; the camera shakes too.
bufflist.desc.terramity.entity_attacking: Boss internal state: rooted in place while attacking (movement speed -30). Players never get it.
bufflist.desc.terramity.flipped_gravity: Gravity is flipped and you "fall" upward. Needs the Cosmilite Sorcerer's Hat on, otherwise it ends at once. Removed above Y=320.
bufflist.desc.terramity.giant_sniffers_h: Giant Sniffer's Hoof active ability: attack damage ×1.25, and targets get launched high into the air.
bufflist.desc.terramity.hexed: When it ends, your current health is halved. Not in creative, with the Stygian Safety Talisman, or with Immunity.
bufflist.desc.terramity.immunity: Removes these every tick: Hunger, Weakness, Wither, Poison, Slowness, Shadowflame, Darkness, Blindness, Dizzy. Also stops Hexed from halving your health when it ends.
bufflist.desc.terramity.lifesteal: Heal when you deal damage: about 15% of the damage after armor, max 2 HP (1 heart) per hit; triggers at most once every 0.2 s.
bufflist.desc.terramity.mirroring: Whenever you deal damage, you take 50% of it back.
bufflist.desc.terramity.misprogrammed: Your hits clear the target's hurt invulnerability, so you can land rapid hits in a row.
bufflist.desc.terramity.mortal_flight: Glide as if wearing an elytra without one.
bufflist.desc.terramity.nyxium_fire: Constant shadowflame damage: 3 per hit, limited by hurt invulnerability, so about once every 0.5 s (about 6 per second). A full set of Stygian Nyx knight armor makes you immune.
bufflist.desc.terramity.ocarina_playing: Playing the Ocarina of Power; nothing else.
bufflist.desc.terramity.phasing: Invulnerable, leaving afterimages as you move, with inverted screen colors; back to normal when it ends.
bufflist.desc.terramity.resourceful_roun: Terramity guns have a {=lvl*10}% chance not to use ammo (+10% per level). Stacks with the Bottomless Ammo Box (+40%) and the Lucky Blanks enchantment.
bufflist.desc.terramity.shadowstep: Walk on air: temporary Shadowstep Blocks appear under you over air, grass or snow layers. Needs the otherworldly warlock armor on, otherwise it ends.
bufflist.desc.terramity.slam_state: Transition state for dash/slam skills: no fall damage, ends on landing with a ground slam (0.4 s of Jump Boost V).
bufflist.desc.terramity.trembling: The camera shakes randomly, harder the more time is left (hidden effect).
bufflist.desc.terramity.tremor: The camera keeps shaking slightly (hidden effect).
bufflist.desc.terramity.ultra_sniffer_fu: While wearing Ultra Sniffer Fur, every attack deals double damage (normally a 25% chance).
bufflist.desc.terramity.universal_transc: Puts you in spectator mode (fly through walls, no damage); you go back to survival/creative when it ends.
bufflist.desc.terramity.warping: Charging a teleport with the Warp Whistle; nothing else.
bufflist.desc.the_bumblezone.hidden: Other mobs' detection range for you drops to 0 (fully unseen). At level II (head fully buried in a Pile of Pollen), bees within 32 blocks targeting you also lose track, and Wrath of the Hive stops calling bees. Wears off about 0.5 s after you leave the pollen.
bufflist.desc.the_bumblezone.paralyzed: Can't move or turn at all, and mob AI basically stops. Max 30 s per application (reapplying extends it). Undead and some mobs are immune; creative/spectator players aren't affected.
bufflist.desc.the_bumblezone.protection_: Calms bees within 32 blocks that are attacking you, and removes your Wrath of the Hive every tick. When a non-bee mob attacks you, it gets Wrath of the Hive at the same level and bees within 32 blocks go after it. Get it by feeding bees or a Honeycomb Brood Block; 300 s by default.
bufflist.desc.the_bumblezone.wrath_of_th: Every second, angers bees within 64 blocks into attacking you and buffs them for as long as this has left: at level I~II only bees that can see you (Speed II, Absorption II, Strength II); from level III they sense you through walls (Speed II, Absorption I, Strength I) and there's a 9% chance per second to spawn a new bee within 30 blocks. Honeycomb Brood Blocks within 8 blocks each have a 15% chance per second to grow faster. Lasts 84 s by default; if bees are still angry at you when it ends, you get level II again. Removed on Peaceful; milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.aerial_collap: Lifted into the air and slammed down: up to 3 s; you rise until 1 s is left, plunge fast in the last 0.5 s, and with 0.25 s left take {=lvl}% of your current health as damage (ignores i-frames). Aerial Collapse applies level 12 + 2 × spell power, max 50.
Caster helper state for Aerial Collapse: hover 5 blocks off the ground with no fall damage build-up, up to 3 s. Can't be removed.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.astral_path_r: Monster marked by Astral Sense: particles show its current pathfinding route and destination every second, with 0.5 s of Glowing when marked. Astral Sense affects monsters within 20 + 5 × spell level blocks, lasting 40 + 5 × spell power s.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.astral_sense: Every 0.25 s, warns you above the hotbar about lit TNT within 8 blocks, monsters within 20 blocks (and 4 blocks of height) targeting or approaching you with their distance, and projectiles flying at you within 30 blocks; also highlights certain entities within 8 blocks. The sky and fog turn purple meanwhile.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.astral_sense_: Every 0.25 s, shows above the hotbar: lit TNT within 8 blocks, the nearest non-empty chest within 12 blocks and its distance, tripwire traps within 8 blocks, and the nearest valuable block within 12 blocks and its distance. The sky and fog turn purple meanwhile.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.azure_frenzy: While holding any tier of Galenic Polarizer in your main hand, attack speed +{=lvl*5}% (of base); switching weapons turns it off. Sneak-casting Galena Shatter with a tier III Polarizer for 10 azure energy gives level X (+50%) for 15 s.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.blackout: Fully spell-locked: can't cast (mob casts get interrupted), can't right-click items, mana doesn't regen or change, plus constant Darkness. Blackout field hits apply 1.5 s, and staying in the field keeps refreshing it to 2.5 s; moving inside the field deals 3 damage per second.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.crimson_desce: Ominous Omen set Crimson Descend: dive down fast while elytra-flying; on landing you release a shockwave and the effect ends, dealing {=amp} damage and knockback to everything within 8 blocks, healing 10% max health per mob hit (15% at night). No fall damage during it. Level is 10 + 10 × blood spell power.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.flames_reborn: Saves your position, dimension and health when applied; when it ends or is removed, you're teleported back and your health is reset to the saved value. A lethal hit during it is survived and triggers the rewind right away. The Flames Reborn spell lasts 11.5 + 4.5 × spell power s (rounded).
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.flare_vacuum: Applied by Gyro Slash hits, 2 s: mobs within 3 blocks that also have it pull toward each other. When it ends, 16 Flame Jets burst out from you in a + or X pattern, each dealing {=amp} damage.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.floodgate: Any single hit is capped at 30% of your max health; the rest is cut off. Each time it caps a hit, waves surge out in 6 directions, each dealing {=amp} damage. The Floodgate spell lasts 10 + 2 × spell level s, at level 2 + spell power.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.jet_steam: While swimming off the ground or elytra-flying, get an extra 0.2 blocks/tick of speed toward where you look each tick; elytra speed caps at 4 blocks/tick. The Jet Steam spell gives 1 + spell power s, doubled if cast while swimming.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.nullflare_fir: Take {=lvl} damage every 2 s. Each hit from a sneak-cast Nullflare adds a level and lasts 10 s; a hit from a normal-cast Nullflare detonates it for ×{=1+0.75*amp} Nullflare damage (using the caster's ice spell power) and removes it.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.nullflare_ice: Adds {=lvl*2} freeze per tick (vanilla thaws 2 per tick outside powder snow), so you only start freezing from level II (about 3.5 s to full at II); once full you get vanilla freeze slowdown and damage. Freeze resets when it ends. Each hit from a normal-cast Nullflare adds a level and lasts 10 s; a hit from a sneak-cast Nullflare detonates it for ×{=1+0.75*amp} Nullflare damage (using the caster's fire spell power) and removes it.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.overloaded: Infernal Devastator overloaded: can't use Flame Volley (hold right-click) or cast Gyro Slash. Flame Volley gives 4 s after 0.35 s of charging; casting Gyro Slash gives 2.75 s. Milk and the like can't remove it.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.psychic_contr: Mind-controlled mob: every 0.5 s it switches to attacking another random non-player mob within 12 blocks. Doesn't work on players.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.reversal: Lasts 0.4 s: all damage taken is negated with no knockback. Right before it ends, the stored damage × (1 + 0.25 × reversal spell power) is thrown as armor-ignoring damage at the nearest target within 5 blocks in front of you, and all your negative effects are cleared. If a projectile hit you during it, you fire one of the same kind where you're looking; with the Nightstalker's Band you also get Assassin VII for 5 s.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.spirit_damage: Damage helper while the Gauntlet of Extinction summons Tremorsaurus spirits, 0.6 s: at about 0.5 s, each spirit within 12 blocks deals {=amp} damage to mobs within 3 blocks of it. 3 for normal, tier I and II; 50% of attack damage (rounded) for tier III.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.third_person_: Forces third-person view, switching back to first person with 0.1 s left. Refreshed to 0.25 s every tick while casting Blackout; can't be removed.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.tidal_grasp: Caster helper state for Tidal Grasp, 0.65 s: when it ends, grabbed targets within 6 blocks take {=amp} spell damage, 3 s of Stunned and 3 s of Wet III. The spell gives level 10 + 3 × spell power.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.tidal_grasp_h: Grabbed by Tidal Grasp: pulled to 2 blocks in front of the caster, mark lasts 0.75 s. When the caster slams down you're stunned for 3 s, get Wet III for 3 s and take damage.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.vigor_siphon: Links you to your summons within 15 blocks: when a summon deals damage you heal {=lvl}% of max health, and when you deal damage the nearest summon heals {=lvl}% of its max health; each direction triggers at most once every 2.5 s. A lethal hit sacrifices the nearest summon instead: you survive at 8 HP, then the effect is removed.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.void_collapse: Lifted into the air and slammed down: up to 3 s; you rise until 1 s is left, plunge fast in the last 0.5 s, and take {=lvl} damage with 0.25 s left. Applied by The Nightwarden's Void Slash, level about half its attack damage.
bufflist.desc.traveloptics.vortex_punch: Caster helper state for Vortex Uppercut, 1.25 s: at 0.8 s you teleport 2.8 blocks behind the nearest Void Vortex within 50 blocks; at the end, if a Void Vortex is within 5 blocks, everything within 3 blocks takes 10 + 10 × spell power damage and gets launched.
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_cave_maps: Disables Xaero's Minimap cave mode; only the surface map shows, even underground.
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_cave_maps_: Disables Xaero's Minimap cave mode; only the surface map shows, even underground (harmful version).
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_entity_rad: Disables Xaero's Minimap entity radar; players, mobs and other entities don't show on the minimap.
Disables Xaero's Minimap entity radar; players, mobs and other entities don't show on the minimap (harmful version).
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_minimap: Disables Xaero's Minimap; the minimap is hidden.
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_minimap_ha: Disables Xaero's Minimap; the minimap is hidden (harmful version, same as No Minimap).
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_waypoints: Disables Xaero's Minimap waypoints; they don't show and can't be used.
bufflist.desc.xaerominimap.no_waypoints_: Disables Xaero's Minimap waypoints; they don't show and can't be used (harmful version).
bufflist.desc.xaeroworldmap.no_cave_maps: Disables Xaero's World Map cave mode; the world map only shows the surface.
Disables Xaero's World Map cave mode; the world map only shows the surface (harmful version).
bufflist.desc.xaeroworldmap.no_world_map: Disables Xaero's World Map; the world map screen can't be opened.
Disables Xaero's World Map; the world map screen can't be opened (harmful version).
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.aphrodis: Adult animals stay in love mode (refreshed every tick, ready to breed right away). No effect on babies.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.breathin: All healing received ×1.5, regardless of level. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.confiden: After a mob hits you, that hit's invulnerability lasts {=lvl*0.3} s longer (+6 ticks per level). Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.craby: Sideways (strafe) speed ×{=1+lvl*0.5} (+50% per level); forward/back unchanged.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.earthy: For players above 18 hunger and not at full health, heals 1 HP about every {=max(0.05,0.5/lvl)} s (0.5 s at I, 0.25 s at II), each heal adding 4 exhaustion (about 1 saturation or hunger point).
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.enjoyabl: Positive effects from food last ×{=1+lvl*0.2} longer (+20% per level). Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.hypnosis: Hypnotized villagers don't like you less when villagers get hurt or killed or iron golems get killed, and won't call the Shrine Maiden as witnesses.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.mature: With Nourishment also active, damage taken is reduced by up to {=lvl*20}% (+20% per level, rounded down); each point blocked uses up 5 s of Nourishment, and if there isn't enough left it blocks what the remaining time allows. Special damage like resistance-bypassing damage isn't reduced.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.meditati: Standing still gives 1 XP every {=max(0.5,3/lvl)} s (3 s at I, faster per level, min 0.5 s); any change in position resets it. Players only.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.refreshi: Immune to all fire damage, and fire on you goes out right away. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.smoothin: Immune to Poison and Wither: existing Poison is cleared, and new Poison or Wither can't be applied. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.sober: Removes Nausea, Youkaifying and Youkaified every tick, and blocks Youkaifying and Youkaified. Can't sleep, and phantoms won't spawn for you.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.unconsci: Mobs don't treat you as a target. Attacking or opening a Loot Crate ends it and puts the Koishi Hat on a 10 s cooldown; getting spotted by the Shrine Maiden ends it too.
bufflist.desc.youkaishomecoming.youkaify: You count as half-youkai: Rumia and other youkai and fairies attack you, and you can use danmaku and Touhou hats. Killing a villager in front of other villagers calls the Shrine Maiden. Human-meat food gives ×2 hunger; each one adds 60 s, and going past 300 s turns this into 1200 s of Youkaified. Milk doesn't remove it.
bufflist.note.attributeslib.sundering: {mod:celestial_overhaul}Celestial Overhaul changes Resistance to damage ×0.8^level and takes over the same calculation, so Sundering's extra damage stops working while you also have Resistance (normally the two cancel at 20% per level).
bufflist.note.irons_spellbooks.abyssal_s: {mod:irons_spellbooks}The Abyssal Shroud spell is disabled and can't be crafted (enabled by default), so you can't normally get this effect.
bufflist.note.irons_spellbooks.echoing_s: {mod:irons_spellbooks}Echoing Strikes multiplier 1.0→0.1 and max level 5→1, so echo damage becomes original damage × {=lvl*0.5}% × spell power × ender spell power (75%→7.5% when applied by the spell), echoes 3~7→3; cooldown 60→180 s, mana cost ×4.
bufflist.note.irons_spellbooks.true_invi: {mod:kubejs}New players get 10 min of True Invisibility the first time they join.
bufflist.note.minecraft.poison: {mod:celestial_overhaul}Celestial Overhaul multiplies damage by max(1, current health × 0.2%), so it only scales up above 500 health.
bufflist.note.minecraft.regeneration: {mod:celestial_overhaul}Celestial Overhaul multiplies healing by max(1, max health × 5%), double at 40 max health.
